hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push'; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && echo 'Pre-push: formatting...' && cargo fmt --all 2>&1 && if ! git diff --quiet; then echo 'Pre-push: cargo fmt changed files. Review and commit them yourself — refusing to amend.'; exit 1; fi && echo 'Pre-push: running clippy...' && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 || { echo 'Clippy failed — fix before pushing'; exit 1; } && echo 'fmt + clippy clean'; fi
